This 2-tier dish rack comes with two removable drip trays to prevent water from freshly washed dishes from dripping onto the lower tier or countertop. This dish rack is designed with R-shaped feet to ensure good stability and load-bearing capacity. It does not shake easily, helping prevent dishes from falling while allowing easy access and convenient storage of cutlery.
